Both of them like fish and water. Nina and Sam had great fun there. Nina learned a lot about science. For example, my cousin is studying French in Belgium this year.
Nina usually has fish for breakfast. They took many photos at the ticket office. There are always many people at the ticket office. In fact, maps are free at the visitor centre.

Nina wrote about the day in the diary. The airport is one of the best places in the city. Nina thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. For example, traffic accidents decreased by twenty percent after the new speed limit.
Nina plays basketball with Sam every Tuesday. Nina likes rainy days best. Sam is interested in cooking.
